onset.Description: TDT epoc time (s from the start of the TDT block)

trial_type.Description: TDT epoc store name (e.g. Tic2/Epoc = TDT tick markers, LATT/RATT = attenuation stores); task triggers are in the TRIG channels (Inpt_RZ2_chnNNN, analog TTL inputs; DataREADME: triggers are up-flanks in an input channel)
